description: The file defines the implementation of the ZoneDao interface, specifically the ZoneDaoImpl class. It provides methods to query Zone entities based on language and country, using QueryDSL and JPA via Spring Data. The class extends a generic DAO implementation and includes two key methods: listByLanguageAndCountry and listByLanguage.

classes.name: ZoneDaoImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the ZoneDao interface, providing data access methods for Zone entities, with custom queries filtered by language and country.

methods.name: listByLanguageAndCountry
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Zone entities filtered by specified language and country.

methods.name: listByLanguage
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Zone entities filtered by specified language.
